aortic-screening-12.title: Proximal abdominal aorta in transverse section
aortic-screening-12.label: Proximal transverse aorta
aortic-screening-12.credit: Christopher Bryczkowski et al., Cureus (2023), Figure 1
aortic-screening-12.reason: Celiac trunk, aorta, IVC, and spine are labeled in the upper transverse window.
aortic-screening-12.note: The celiac trunk is outlined above the aorta. Inferior vena cava and spinal stripe are identified by the authors. The source does not establish that the three figures share a participant. Published annotations and native orientation retained. Lossless WebP conversion at original size.

aortic-screening-30.title: Mid abdominal aorta in transverse section
aortic-screening-30.label: Mid transverse aorta
aortic-screening-30.credit: Christopher Bryczkowski et al., Cureus (2023), Figure 2
aortic-screening-30.reason: The labeled mid-aortic cross-section retains the SMA, IVC, and posterior spine.
aortic-screening-30.note: The anterior superior mesenteric artery profile is marked. The image does not identify renal arterial origins or establish an infrarenal level. The original caliper endpoints are retained. The source does not establish that the three figures share a participant. Published annotations and native orientation retained. Lossless WebP conversion at original size.

aortic-screening-48.title: Distal abdominal aorta in transverse section
aortic-screening-48.label: Distal transverse aorta
aortic-screening-48.credit: Christopher Bryczkowski et al., Cureus (2023), Figure 3
aortic-screening-48.reason: The labeled distal scan shows an undivided aortic cross-section with IVC and spine.
aortic-screening-48.note: The iliac bifurcation is outside the image and the distance to it is unspecified. The original caliper endpoints are retained. The source does not establish that the three figures share a participant. Published annotations and native orientation retained. Lossless WebP conversion at original size.
